name: Face You Less
source:
Face You Less is a short, black and white visual novel where someone is in bed with you and you must figure out who. Will you accept them in your life or not?

[from [url=https://axlelism.itch.io/faceyouless]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《Face You Less》是一部简短的黑白视觉小说，其中有人与你同床共枕，你必须弄清楚是谁。在你的生活中你会接受它们吗？

[来自[url=https://axlelism.itch.io/faceyouless]itch.io[/url]]
